description: Consensus with Bioconductor DECIPHER ConsensusSequence semantics (DNA, RNA or protein): at each position the least frequent characters are dropped while they represent less than 'threshold' of the sequences and the rest are encoded with an IUPAC degeneracy code (DNA/RNA) or B/Z/J/X (protein); noConsensusChar where the consensus carries less than minInformation. Gaps '-'/'.', masks '+'.

sequences.description: Aligned sequences (unequal lengths allowed, as in DECIPHER).

threshold.description: Fraction of sequence information that may be lost at a position, in [0, 1) (default 0.05).

ambiguity.description: Split IUPAC degeneracy codes between their residues (default true).

noConsensusChar.description: Single character from the alphabet for positions without consensus (default '+').

minInformation.description: Minimum fraction of information in (0, 1]; default 1 - threshold.

includeNonLetters.description: DECIPHER includeNonLetters (default false: gaps/masks are counted; true: they are left out, as DECIPHER's own examples show).

consensus.description: DECIPHER consensus (length of the longest sequence)

errors.message: At least one sequence is required
noConsensusChar must be exactly one character
